name: correctness-calibration
description: Calibration eval for judge-correctness. Runs correctness-classify against the labeled correctness-calibration dataset and scores the emitted verdict EXACTLY against the human label. Pass rate = verdict accuracy; the per-row drilldown shows exactly which pairs the judge mis-calls (and in which direction — over-strict on paraphrases vs. over-lenient on fluent contradictions), which is what you tune the rubric against. Run it from the Evals page, or replay the dataset through /api/runs/start.
